name: std::future_category
intro: Obtains a reference to the static error category object for the errors related to futures and promises. The object is required to override the virtual function error_category::name() to return a pointer to the string "future". It is used to identify error codes provided in the exceptions of type std::future_error.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to the static object of unspecified runtime type, derived from std::error_category.
